tools.name: get_my_page
tools.description: Show the user's page: profile, theme, social icons and every block with its id.

tools.name: claim_handle
tools.description: Create the user's page at stomp.to/{handle}. Only works if they don't have a page yet.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Change the display name, bio, whether the small "Made with stomp.to" badge shows, and whether visitors (and their AI) can subscribe by email or send the user messages. Omit fields to keep them.

tools.name: add_link
tools.description: Add a link button to the page. Optionally schedule it (it shows only between startsAt and endsAt) or put it in the spotlight.

tools.name: add_header
tools.description: Add a text header that groups the links below it.

tools.name: add_embed
tools.description: Embed a YouTube video, a Spotify track, album, playlist, podcast or artist, an Instagram post or reel, or a TikTok video, so it plays on the page. TikTok needs the full tiktok.com/@name/video/… link, not a short vm.tiktok.com one.

tools.name: add_posts
tools.description: Add a swipeable row of up to 6 Instagram posts or reels and TikTok videos, in the order given, with an optional title such as "Latest on Instagram". Use full links (instagram.com/p/…, instagram.com/reel/…, tiktok.com/@name/video/…). The row doesn't update by itself: replace the links with update_blo

tools.name: add_music
tools.description: Add a song or album as a button with its cover art. Pass one Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer or YouTube link: stomp.to reads the title, artist and cover, and finds the same release on Spotify, Apple Music and Deezer when the names match. Visitors tap it and pick their streaming app. Add other services

tools.name: update_block
tools.description: Edit a block by id: title/url for links, text for headers, url for embeds, title and streaming links for music buttons, urls and rowTitle for rows of posts. visible=false hides it without deleting. startsAt/endsAt schedule it (null clears); spotlight=true shows it first, highlighted.

tools.name: reorder_blocks
tools.description: Set the order of all blocks, top to bottom. Pass every block id exactly once.

tools.name: add_social
tools.description: Add a social profile icon (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and 40 more are detected from the URL). Replaces an existing icon for the same platform.

tools.name: remove_social
tools.description: Delete a social icon by id.

tools.name: set_theme
tools.description: Pick a preset (clean, midnight, sunset, ocean, forest, paper, neon, bubblegum) and/or override parts of it. Colors are "#rrggbb". Switching preset resets colors to that preset before applying overrides.

tools.name: import_from_linktree
tools.description: Copy links, section headers, YouTube embeds, social icons, name, bio and avatar from a public Linktree page. By default adds to the bottom of the page; replace=true clears existing links and icons first.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Page views, link clicks (with click-through rate per link) and top countries.

tools.name: list_subscribers
tools.description: Email addresses of people who subscribed to the user's updates from their page, newest first. Only confirmed addresses opted in; pending ones haven't clicked the confirmation email yet. The user sends updates with their own email or newsletter tool.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: The latest messages visitors (or their AI) sent the user through their page, newest first. Each was also emailed to the user.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_subscribers, list_messages · Public sink: update_profile, add_embed, list_subscribers · Destructive: remove_block, remove_social.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_subscribers, list_messages · Public sink: update_profile, add_embed, list_subscribers · Destructive: remove_block, remove_social

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
